name: Quick Play
description: Puts a Quick Play bar under the main menu's Play button that jumps straight back into your last played level. Its chevron opens a Recent Levels browser that fills in automatically as you play (tap + on a level screen to add one by hand, X to remove one). The optional 'Keep far levels saved' setting pulls a far-back download back to the top of the saved list when you play it.

enabled.name: Enable Quick Play
enabled.description: Show the Quick Play button on the main menu and the add button on level screens. OFF restores the original game exactly.

max-recents.name: Max recent levels
max-recents.description: How many recently played levels the Recent Levels list keeps at most.

keep-saved.name: Keep far levels saved
keep-saved.description: When ON, a downloaded level you play from beyond the front-page saved list is pulled back into the saved list so it stays saved after you exit the level. Prevents 'Load Failed!' on far-back downloads.
